(Hyper-Realistic Fashion Close-Up – Extreme Detail)
Ultra-hyper realistic extreme close-up fashion beauty portrait, macro facial photography, camera distance extremely close, filling the entire frame with the face.
Visible natural skin texture with individual pores, micro-wrinkles, faint peach fuzz, tiny skin imperfections, subtle redness around the nose and cheeks, realistic oil sheen on the T-zone.
High-end fashion makeup applied flawlessly yet realistically:
– finely milled foundation sitting naturally on the skin, slightly settling into pores
– soft gradient blush diffused into cheekbones
– eyeshadow with visible powder grain and smooth pigment blending
– sharp eyeliner edges with micro feathering
– mascara showing individual separated eyelashes, slight clumping for realism
– lips with detailed lip lines, natural creases, soft satin lipstick texture, no plastic smoothness

Studio macro lighting: soft diffused key light revealing skin texture, gentle side light emphasizing pores and micro-contrast, subtle shadow falloff for depth, no beauty retouch smoothing.
True-to-life color science, cinematic contrast, high dynamic range, physically accurate skin subsurface scattering.

Shot on a macro cinema lens, ultra-shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on eyes and skin surface, background completely melted into creamy bokeh.
Photorealistic, 8K resolution, extreme clarity, editorial fashion photography, raw realism, zero airbrushing, zero CGI skin.

Negative Prompt:
plastic skin, waxy face, beauty filter, over-smoothed skin, airbrushed, doll face, unreal pores, fake texture, painterly, CGI look, anime, illustration, low detail, blurry, soft focus, excessive glow, flat lighting
